description: This is a Python test script that includes multiple test functions designed to verify the behavior of a system related to RDM packages and RFC features. The tests involve executing shell commands, checking logs for specific messages, and asserting expected outcomes for system configurations and download processes.

methods.name: test_RFC_Set_Handler()
methods.description: Tests setting RFC feature to false using a shell command and verifies the success message in result.

methods.name: test_is_rdm_packages_install_RFC_disabled()
methods.description: Checks that the 'rdm' process starts when RFC is disabled.

methods.name: test_on_demand_download_RFC_disabled()
methods.description: Verifies that logs contain specific messages indicating that on-demand download is disabled when RFC is off.

methods.name: test_RFC_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Tests setting RFC feature to true via shell command and verifies success message.

methods.name: test_rdm_packages_install_RFC_enabled()
methods.description: Checks that the 'rdm' process starts when RFC is enabled.

methods.name: test_on_demand_download_RFC_enabled()
methods.description: Verifies logs contain messages indicating that on-demand download is enabled with RFC, including starting download and actual download messages.
